description: This file defines types, constants, and functions related to validating and managing safe binary semantics, including rules for specific binaries like jq, awk, sed, and their variants.

methods.name: normalizeSafeBinName
methods.description: Normalizes a raw binary name by trimming, converting to lowercase, removing extensions, and extracting the filename component.

methods.name: getSafeBinSemanticRule
methods.description: Retrieves the semantic validation rule for a given binary name after normalization.

methods.name: validateSafeBinSemantics
methods.description: Validates the semantics of a safe binary based on its rules and parameters.

methods.name: listRiskyConfiguredSafeBins
methods.description: Lists configured safe binaries that have associated warnings, indicating potential security risks.
